label_conventions.category: UPPER_SNAKE_CASE, enclosed in angle brackets; historical action names do not establish an operation

limitations: Rules search the entire normalized input, often without full-prefix or component-boundary constraints.
Only HIVE_RULES and CATEGORY_RULES are consulted by the original entry point; OBJECT_RULES and DETAIL_RULES are unused.
Alias branches bypass CATEGORY_RULES and emit ALIGNED_ACTION.
Cleanup lowercases, changes forward slashes, strips leading separators and removes wow6432node segments; these transformations are not the new knowledge identity contract.
Projection retains only the first three relative components and the terminal component; middle layers may be omitted.
Category/action labels and marked risk labels require taxonomy review; they are not observed operations, risk findings or confirmed functional knowledge.
Regex constants may be unused; original source text is retained for exact order, preprocessing and fallback reconstruction.

import re
"""
Registry 標準化規則。

Problem:
    Registry path 的高基數字串會把同一類事件切得很碎，導致模型學到的是版本號、GUID
    這些雜訊，而不是語意上真正重要的配置區段。

Design:
    以規則把高頻 Registry 路徑壓成穩定的語意 token，讓下游可以在較低維度上比較事件。
"""
GUID_PATTERN = r"\{[A-F0-9]{8}-[A-F0-9]{4}-[A-F0-9]{4}-[A-F0-9]{4}-[A-F0-9]{12}\}"
SID_PATTERN = r"S-1-5-\d+(-\d+)+"
PATH_LIKE_PATTERN = r"[A-Za-z]:\\(?:[^\\\/:*?\"<>|\r\n]+\\)*[^\\\/:*?\"<>|\r\n]*"

# 先把原始 hive 名稱統一，後面所有規則都建立在這個共通基準上。
HIVE_RULES = [
    (re.compile(r"HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE|HKLM", re.IGNORECASE), "HKLM"),
    (re.compile(r"HKEY_CURRENT_USER|HKCU", re.IGNORECASE), "HKCU"),
    (re.compile(r"HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT|HKCR", re.IGNORECASE), "HKCR"),
    (re.compile(r"HKEY_USERS|HKU", re.IGNORECASE), "HKU"),
    (re.compile(r"HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG|HKCC", re.IGNORECASE), "HKCC"),
]

# Object / Target 類規則：保留 Registry 結構，但合併高頻雜訊路徑。
OBJECT_RULES = [
    # 搜尋索引相關路徑，對語意影響小但出現頻率高，適合合併。
    (re.compile(r"\\Windows Search", re.IGNORECASE), "search_indexer"),
    
    # 2. 系統日誌與事件追蹤 (針對 Services\EventLog)
    (re.compile(r"\\Services\\EventLog", re.IGNORECASE), "sys_eventlog"),

    # 副檔名與媒體類型定義，這些位置常攜帶腳本或可執行檔關聯。
    (re.compile(r"^(HKCR|HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT|\\Software\\Classes)\\\.(ps1|psm1|vbs|js|bat|cmd|pl|vbe|jse|wsf|wsh)(\\|$)", re.IGNORECASE), "script_vector"),
    (re.compile(r"^(HKCR|HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT|\\Software\\Classes)\\\.(exe|com|scr|pif|msi|cpl|msc|ade|adp|asp|reg|inf)(\\|$)", re.IGNORECASE), "exec_vector"),
    (re.compile(r"(\\\.[a-zA-Z0-9]+|\\Media Type\\Extensions\\\.[a-z0-9]+)(\\|$)", re.IGNORECASE), "file_extension"),

    # 4. 安全性憑證與密碼學 (熱點：SystemCertificates, Cryptography, Enrollments)
    (re.compile(r"\\(SystemCertificates|EnterpriseCertificates|Cryptography|AuthRoot|Disallowed|ROOT|Trust|Enrollments)(\\|$)", re.IGNORECASE), "security_cert"),
    
    # 安全防護引擎與自我防護相關設定。
    (re.compile(r"\\(Windows Defender|Microsoft Antimalware|RemovalTools\\MRT|AMSI|SecurityHealthService|MpEngine)(\\|$)", re.IGNORECASE), "security_engine"),

    # 系統原則與設定管理。
    (re.compile(r"\\(PolicyManager|Policies|UpdatePolicy|Group Policy|Provisioning\\CSPs|WindowsSelfHost|WaaS|ExpressionEvaluators)(\\|$)", re.IGNORECASE), "system_policy"),
    
    # 檔案系統物件與關聯。
    (re.compile(r"\\(Folder|Directory|AllFilesystemObjects|LibraryFolder|ShellFolders|FileSystem|SystemFileAssociations)(\\|$)", re.IGNORECASE), "fs_object"),

    # 虛擬化與 UWP 沙箱位置。
    (re.compile(r"(^\\REGISTRY\\A\\|\\DeliveryOptimization|\\LocalState|\\Events|\\AppModel|\\ActivatableClasses)(\\|$)", re.IGNORECASE), "virtual_registry"),

    # 網路組件與協議堆疊。
    (re.compile(r"\\(Tcpip|WinSock2|Winsock|Dnscache|Tcpip6|NetBT|WcmSvc|NetworkProvider|SecurityProviders|DNS)(\\|$)", re.IGNORECASE), "network_stack"),
    
    # 核心系統組件與執行環境。
    (re.compile(r"\\(CurrentVersion|Session Manager|ProductOptions|WindowsRuntime|ActivatableClassId|Hvsi|Lsa|SafeBoot|WMI|ContentIndex|Setup|CI|PriorityControl|PowerShell)(\\|$)", re.IGNORECASE), "sys_runtime"),
    
    # 應用程式框架與 .NET。
    (re.compile(r"\\(\.NETFramework|Fusion|PublisherPolicy|Assemblies|NET Framework Setup)(\\|$)", re.IGNORECASE), "dotnet_framework"),

    # 應用程式行為追蹤。
    (re.compile(r"\\(bam|MuiCache|UserAssist)(\\|$)", re.IGNORECASE), "app_tracing"),

    # 特定應用程式與多媒體配置。
    (re.compile(r"\\(Office|OneDrive|Internet Explorer|ActiveMovie|DirectShow|MediaObjects|Media Foundation|Media Type|Scrunch)(\\|$)", re.IGNORECASE), "app_specific_config"),

    # 使用者介面與在地化設定。
    (re.compile(r"\\(Control Panel|Input\\Settings|Input\\Locales|LanguageProfile|Nls|LanguageOverlay|MUI|TabletTip|HwkSettings|MTFKeyboardMappings)(\\|$)", re.IGNORECASE), "user_ui_locale"),

    # 硬體與設備配置。
    (re.compile(r"\\(DeviceClasses|Power|PowerSettings|Display|HDAUDIO|PCI|USB|Enum|HardwareConfig|VIDEO|DEVICEMAP|HARDWARE\\DESCRIPTION|GraphicsDrivers)(\\|$)", re.IGNORECASE), "hardware_cfg"),

    # 保留一個顯式註解的例外規則，方便未來擴充使用者類別劫持。
    #(re.compile(r"^(HKCU|HKU\\[S0-9-]+)\\Software\\Classes", re.IGNORECASE), "user_class_hijack"),

    # 檔案類型與 App 關聯。
    (re.compile(r"\\(Applications|[A-Za-z0-9]+(?:file|html|url|assocfile|exefile|batfile|cmdfile|vbsfile|piffile|regfile|mscfile))(\\|$)", re.IGNORECASE), "app_assoc"),
    
    # 現代應用程式框架。
    (re.compile(r"\\(AppX[A-Za-z0-9]*|ActivatableClasses|AutoGenerated|PackagedCom)(\\|$)", re.IGNORECASE), "appx_framework"),

    # 根節點與帳戶，避免 hive 名稱被視為泛化字串。
    (re.compile(r"^(HKLM|HKCU|HKCR|HKU|HKCC|HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE|HKEY_CURRENT_USER|HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT|HKEY_USERS|HKU\\[S0-9._-]+|HKU\\.DEFAULT|HKU\\S-1-5-[0-9-]+)$", re.IGNORECASE), "root_hive"),

    # 系統安裝、GUID 與元件分類。
    (re.compile(r"(\\Control\\\{[A-F0-9-]{36}\}|\\Installer|\\Class|\\Results)(\\|$)", re.IGNORECASE), "sys_install_guid"),

    # 若維持 None，呼叫端可以保留原始文字作為最後 fallback。
    (re.compile(r"\\(CLSID|Interface|TypeLib|AudioEngine|MSXML2)(\\|$)", re.IGNORECASE), None),
]

# Detail / Modifier 類規則：補足操作、狀態與 UI 修飾資訊。
DETAIL_RULES = [
    # 執行與指令相關資訊。
    (re.compile(r"\\(Command|ddeexec|StubPath|shproc|AppInit_DLLs)(\\|$)", re.IGNORECASE), "EXEC_ACTION"),
    
    # 組件與參數配置。
    (re.compile(r"\\(InprocServer32|LocalServer32|InprocHandler32|Instance|Parameters|Options)(\\|$)", re.IGNORECASE), "COM_CONFIG"),
    
    # 策略與權限控制。
    (re.compile(r"\\(PolicyManager|Security|AccessControl|Permissions|Settings|Restrictions)(\\|$)", re.IGNORECASE), "POLICY_SETTING"),

    # 狀態、快取與計數。
    (re.compile(r"\\(Cache|Volatile|Status|Stats|CurrentConfig|Enum)(\\|$)", re.IGNORECASE), "RUNTIME_STATE"),

    # Shell / UI 修飾資訊。
    (re.compile(r"\\ShellEx\\ContextMenuHandlers", re.IGNORECASE), "CONTEXT_MENU"),
    (re.compile(r"\\ShellEx\\PropertySheetHandlers", re.IGNORECASE), "PROPERTY_SHEET"),
    (re.compile(r"\\ShellEx\\IconHandler", re.IGNORECASE), "ICON_HANDLER"),
    (re.compile(r"\\shell\\open\\NeverDefault", re.IGNORECASE), "NEVER_DEFAULT"),
    (re.compile(r"\\shell\\open", re.IGNORECASE), "OPEN_BEHAVIOR"),
    (re.compile(r"\\DefaultIcon", re.IGNORECASE), "ICON_PATH"),
    (re.compile(r"\\(NoStaticDefaultVerb|NoOpenWith|AlwaysShowExt|NeverShowExt)", re.IGNORECASE), "UI_HINT"),
]
# Action 類規則：標記具體行為或語意角色。
CATEGORY_RULES = [

    # Auto-start registration。
    (re.compile(r"\\CurrentVersion\\Run(?:Once)?(\\|$)", re.IGNORECASE), "RUN"),

    (re.compile(r"\\(CurrentVersion\\Schedule\\TaskCache|Tasks)", re.IGNORECASE), "TASK"),

    (re.compile(r"\\CurrentVersion\\Winlogon", re.IGNORECASE), "WINLOGON"),

    (re.compile(r"\\Image File Execution Options\\", re.IGNORECASE), "IFEO"),

    (re.compile(r"\\CLSID\\.*\\(InprocServer32|LocalServer32)", re.IGNORECASE), "COM"),
    (re.compile(r"\\Shell\\Open\\Command", re.IGNORECASE), "SHELL_CMD"),
    (re.compile(r"\\Software\\Classes\\\.(exefile|comfile|batfile|cmdfile|scrfile|piffile|[^\\]+)", re.IGNORECASE), "FILE_ASSOC"),

def _record_trace(collector, rule_id, operation, before, after, matched=True, **metadata):
    """Append an ordered, versioned legacy decision without changing its output."""
    if collector is not None:
        collector.append({"rule_id": rule_id, "rule_version": "legacy-v1",
                          "operation": operation, "before": before, "after": after,
                          "matched": bool(matched), **metadata})

def standardize_registry_keys(registry_key, mapping_collector=None, trace_collector=None):
    if not isinstance(registry_key, str) or not registry_key.strip():
        result = "<NON_KEY>/<NONE>/<NONE>/<NONE>/<NONE>"
        _record_trace(trace_collector, "registry.invalid", "fallback", registry_key, result)
        return result

    # step 1: 先做字串清理，讓後續規則只面對一致的路徑格式。
    raw_key = registry_key.lower().replace("/", "\\").strip()
    key = raw_key.lstrip("\\").replace("wow6432node\\", "")
    key = re.sub(r'\\+', r'\\', key)
    
    _record_trace(trace_collector, "registry.clean", "normalize", registry_key, raw_key)
    _record_trace(trace_collector, "registry.structure_cleanup", "normalize", raw_key, key,
                  limitation="Legacy cleanup removes wow6432node and leading separators.")

    # step 2: 先判定原始 hive，這會影響後面要套用哪一組語意合併規則。
    orig_hive = "OTHER"
    for index, (p, t) in enumerate(HIVE_RULES):
        if p.search(raw_key):
            orig_hive = t
            _record_trace(trace_collector, f"registry.hive.{index}", "classify", raw_key, t,
                          pattern=p.pattern, span=list(p.search(raw_key).span()))
            break

    # step 3: 依 hive 與資料夾型態做語意對齊。
    hive_token = orig_hive
    is_alias_target = False
    
    before_alias = key
    # Classes / FileExts / PackagedCom 這類路徑代表等價語意但字串細節很多。
    if any(k in key for k in ["software\\classes", "hkcr", "explorer\\fileexts", "packagedcom"]):
        hive_token = "HK_CLASSES_ALIAS"
        is_alias_target = True
        key = key.replace("hkey_current_user\\", "").replace("hkcu\\", "") \
                 .replace("hkey_local_machine\\", "").replace("hklm\\", "") \
                 .replace("software\\classes\\", "").replace("hkey_classes_root\\", "") \
                 .replace("hkcr\\", "").replace("software\\microsoft\\windows\\currentversion\\explorer\\fileexts\\", "") \
                 .replace("packagedcom\\", "")
        key = re.sub(r"^(clsid|appid|interface|typelib)", "COM_OBJECT", key, flags=re.I)
        
    # Software\Microsoft 與 Software\Policies\Microsoft 常代表同一類配置意圖。
    elif "software\\microsoft" in key or "software\\policies\\microsoft" in key:
        hive_token = "HK_SOFTWARE_MS_ALIAS"
        key = key.replace("hklm\\software\\microsoft\\", "").replace("hkcu\\software\\microsoft\\", "") \
                 .replace("hklm\\software\\policies\\microsoft\\", "").replace("hkcu\\software\\policies\\microsoft\\", "") \
                 .replace("software\\microsoft\\", "").replace("software\\policies\\microsoft\\", "")
    else:
        # 一般 hive 路徑直接移除前綴，留下可比較的相對結構。
        if "hklm\\" in key: hive_token = "HKLM"; key = key.replace("hklm\\", "")
        elif "hkcu\\" in key: hive_token = "HKCU"; key = key.replace("hkcu\\", "")
        elif "hku\\" in key: hive_token = "HKU"; key = key.replace("hku\\", "")
        elif "hkey_local_machine\\" in key: hive_token = "HKLM"; key = key.replace("hkey_local_machine\\", "")

    _record_trace(trace_collector, "registry.alias." + hive_token.lower(), "alias",
                  before_alias, key, before_alias != key, hive_token=hive_token)

    # step 4: 抽出前幾層路徑作為穩定的結構特徵。
    raw_parts = [p for p in key.split('\\') if p]
    obj1 = f"<{raw_parts[0].upper()}>" if len(raw_parts) > 0 else "<ROOT>"
    obj2 = f"<{raw_parts[1].upper()}>" if len(raw_parts) > 1 else "<NONE>"
    obj3 = f"<{raw_parts[2].upper()}>" if len(raw_parts) > 2 else "<NONE>"

    # step 5: Action 標籤補上操作語意。
    if is_alias_target or hive_token == "HK_SOFTWARE_MS_ALIAS":
        action_token = "<ALIGNED_ACTION>"
        _record_trace(trace_collector, "registry.category.aligned", "classify", raw_key, action_token,
                      limitation="Alias branch bypasses category matching; this is not an observed operation.")
    else:
        action_token = "<OTHER_ACTION>"
        for index, (p, t) in enumerate(CATEGORY_RULES):
            if p.search(raw_key):
                action_token = f"<{t}>"
                _record_trace(trace_collector, f"registry.category.{index}", "classify", raw_key, action_token,
                              pattern=p.pattern, span=list(p.search(raw_key).span()))
                break
        if action_token == "<OTHER_ACTION>":
            _record_trace(trace_collector, "registry.category.fallback", "fallback", raw_key, action_token, False)

    # step 6: 末端節點保留，作為最細粒度的辨識資訊。
    terminal_name = "<NONE>"
    if len(raw_parts) > 0:
        term = raw_parts[-1]
        terminal_name = f"<{term}>"

    # * 將 hive / path / action / terminal 組成固定輸出格式，方便下游直接比對。
    normalized = f"<{hive_token}>/{obj1}/{obj2}/{obj3}/{action_token}/{terminal_name}"

    _record_trace(trace_collector, "registry.project", "project", raw_parts, normalized,
                  retained_indices=sorted(set(list(range(min(3, len(raw_parts)))) + ([len(raw_parts)-1] if raw_parts else []))),
                  limitation="Legacy output retains first three relative segments and terminal; middle layers may be omitted.")

    if mapping_collector is not None:
        mapping_collector.append((registry_key, normalized))
    return normalized
